faq.intro: These answers describe how the site works. What governs a promotion is its Official Rules.

q1.answer: [[brand.name]] is an online store. Buying eligible merchandise may earn promotional entries into the promotion described in the Official Rules.
q1.question: What is [[brand.name]]?

q2.answer: No. What you buy is merchandise. Entries are a promotional benefit awarded under the Official Rules, and they are not the product you pay for.
q2.question: Am I buying entries?

q3.answer: Whether a promotion offers a free method of entry, and how it works, is stated in the Official Rules of that promotion.
q3.question: Is there a free way to take part?

q4.answer: Eligibility is defined in the Official Rules of each promotion, and nowhere else on this site.
q4.question: Who may take part?

q5.answer: Winner selection is described in the Official Rules of each promotion. When the drawing is carried out by an independent administrator, the promotion page says so.
q5.question: How is a winner selected?

q6.answer: The promotion page keeps reporting where the process stands: with the administrator, in winner verification, or complete.
q6.question: What happens after a promotion closes?

pickup.body: It's handed to you at the store location when you pay. No shipping: you pay {total}.

delivery.title: Ship it to my home
delivery.body: Shipping of {shipping} is added: you pay {total}.
delivery.unavailable: Home delivery is not available yet.

checkout.noPaymentMethodsTitle: No payment methods are available right now
checkout.noPaymentMethodsBody: Please try again later or contact us.

reserve.title: Fill in your details and tap Reserve
reserve.note: Once you reserve, we'll show you how to pay with Zelle or Venmo and you upload your receipt right there!

orderConfirmation.title: Thank you for your order
orderConfirmation.intro: We have your order. Here is what happens next.
orderConfirmation.rulesNote: Refunds, chargebacks and disqualification can change the entries associated with an order, as described in the Official Rules.

cash.pendingTitle: Pay in cash at a store location
cash.pendingBody: Give this order number at a store location and pay {total} in cash. Nothing has been charged yet: your order is pending payment, and your entries are generated when the store confirms it.
cash.paidBody: The store confirmed your cash payment. Your entries are generated with the same rules as a card purchase.
cash.pickupBody: Your order is handed to you right there when you pay. No shipping.

orderConfirmation.reservedIntro: Pay with Zelle or Venmo and upload your payment screenshot right here.

transfer.pendingTitle: Pay for your order and upload your receipt
transfer.venmoQrHint: Scan it with your camera or from the Venmo app.
transfer.noRecipient: Message us on WhatsApp and we'll send you the payment details.
transfer.step2Title: In the payment note, write your order number:
transfer.step2Body: That's how we know the payment is for this order.
transfer.uploadHint: Photo or screenshot in JPG, PNG or WebP, up to 5 MB.
transfer.entriesNote: Your order stays reserved until the organizer confirms the payment. Your entries are generated at that moment.
transfer.reviewBody: The organizer will review your payment and confirm it on WhatsApp at {phone}.
transfer.reviewBodyNoPhone: The organizer will review your payment and confirm it on WhatsApp.
transfer.wrongReceipt: Uploaded the wrong screenshot? Upload another one
transfer.paidBody: The organizer confirmed your payment. Your entries are generated under the same rules as any other purchase.
transfer.cancelledBody: This order was cancelled and can no longer be paid. If you already sent the payment, message us.

chrome.provisionalCapabilities: This session did not include the capabilities published by the backend, so the menu is empty. It usually means the deployed API is older than the panel; once it is updated, the menu comes back on its own.

account.title: My account
account.description: The email you sign in with, and your password.
account.emailHint: This is the email you use to enter the admin panel.
account.passwordIntro: Type the one you use now and then the new one twice. When you save it, any other computer or phone signed in with this account is signed out; you stay in.
account.newHint: We check the requirements when you save.
account.newHintMinimum: At least {count} characters. A short phrase works well.
account.saved: Done. Your new password is saved; use it the next time you sign in.

access.signInTitle: Sign in to the admin panel
access.signInBody: This area is for staff accounts.
access.notStaffTitle: This account does not have access to the admin panel
access.notStaffBody: You are signed in with a customer account. Nothing is wrong with it; it simply has no admin role.
access.forbiddenTitle: You do not have access to this screen
access.forbiddenBody: Your account is not allowed to open this screen. If you need it, ask whoever manages the panel accounts for access.

auth.signInBody: Use the same account as in the store. For safety, sessions here are stricter.
auth.lockedRetry: This account is locked. You can try again in about {minutes} minutes.

dashboard.title: Dashboard
dashboard.description: A snapshot of your store and your promotion, right now. Click or tap a figure to open its section.
dashboard.noPromotion: No promotion is open right now.
dashboard.activeEntriesHint: Entries your customers hold right now.
dashboard.amoePendingHint: Each one is a person waiting for an answer.
dashboard.adjustmentsPendingHint: Entry corrections waiting for your approval.

confirm.reasonHint: It is saved in the history and cannot be changed later.
confirm.noteHint: Add anything the reason does not explain on its own.
confirm.done: Done. It is saved in the history.

promotions.title: Promotions
promotions.noRulesConsequence: Without a published rules version, the store does not show the full promotion hero for this promotion.
promotions.rulesNoCapabilityTitle: You cannot see the rules versions
promotions.rulesNoCapabilityBody: Your account is not allowed to see the rules versions.
promotions.rulesEmptyBody: A promotion cannot go live without one.
promotions.missingKeysBody: The promotion cannot be activated until each one is settled with your attorney.
promotions.emptyBody: Create the first promotion with the button above.
promotions.emptyBodyReadOnly: No promotion has been created yet.
promotions.newBody: It starts as a draft. Activating it will require the period and an active rules version.
promotions.fieldTimezoneHint: Every date and deadline is counted in this zone. It cannot be changed later.
promotions.windowHint: Local time in the promotion's legal zone ({timezone}).
promotions.windowHintCreate: Local time in the legal zone you choose above.
promotions.heroSectionHint: What the home page hero shows: a short line under the title and the prize photo. Fill in both languages or leave both empty.
promotions.fieldTaglineHint: For example, the prizes and the dates. It does not replace the Official Rules.
promotions.fieldHeroAltHint: What the photo shows, for people who cannot see it. Leave both empty if it adds nothing to the title.
promotions.gallerySectionHint: More photos for the home page carousel, shown after the prize photo in this order. Up to 5; leave a slot empty to skip it.
promotions.bothLanguages: Both languages are required: the store is shown in both.
promotions.scheduleBody: Publishes the period. It is reversible and grants no entries.
promotions.needsWindow: Before scheduling, set when it starts and when it ends.
promotions.unscheduleBody: Moves it back to draft: it is no longer shown on the site and cannot be activated until it is scheduled again. Use it for a promotion that will not launch.
promotions.confirmUnschedule: I confirm I want to remove this promotion from the shop.
promotions.activateBody: Opens the promotion: from then on, eligible merchandise starts granting promotional entries. Requires a reason.
promotions.needsRulesVersion: It cannot be activated yet: it has no active rules version. That version carries what the lawyer's Official Rules set.
promotions.closeBody: Ends the entry period. Requires a reason.
promotions.noTransition: No action is available from here in this state.
promotions.transitionNoCapability: Your account is not allowed to do this.
promotions.reasonTextHint: Kept in the audit trail next to the reason.
promotions.confirmSchedule: I confirm I want to schedule this promotion.
promotions.confirmActivate: I confirm I want to activate this promotion.
promotions.confirmClose: I confirm I want to close this promotion.
promotions.engineSaid: The system refused it for this reason:
promotions.noUpdateCapability: You can see this promotion, but your account cannot edit it.

shipping.title: Shipping
shipping.description: Flat rate charged once per order when it includes merchandise.
shipping.rules: Entry packages are not shipped. Shipping does not generate entries. It can never be zero: it is always charged.
shipping.noneTitle: There is no shipping rate yet
shipping.noneBody: Until you set one, carts with merchandise can't be paid for. Entry packages still can.
shipping.amountHint: For example: 7.99. It applies to new orders; existing orders keep the shipping they paid.
shipping.saved: Rate saved. It now applies in the cart and at checkout.
shipping.readOnly: You can view the rate, but changing it requires the permission to edit the catalog.

brand.title: Brand
brand.description: Name, logo, colors, legal details and contact info shown across the site.
brand.intro: Changes apply to the public site as soon as you save. No redeploy needed.
brand.initialValues: These are still the template's starting values. Save once to make the brand yours.
brand.readOnly: You can view the brand, but changing it requires the permission to update the brand.
brand.saved: Brand saved. The site already shows it.
brand.nameHint: Shown in page titles, emails and the footer. Up to 60 characters.
brand.wordmarkLeadHint: The text logo in the header, for example "Mi". Up to 30 characters.
brand.wordmarkTailHint: Painted in the brand color, for example "Marca". Leave it empty for a single line.
brand.logoHint: Optional. A PNG with a transparent background looks best. Without one, the site shows the template symbol.
brand.colorBrandHint: The main color: the wordmark's second line, buttons and highlights. A very dark color is lightened automatically on the dark background so it stays readable.
brand.patternHint: How visible the topographic pattern is on dark surfaces. 0 hides it; 40 is the maximum.
brand.legalIntro: Printed in the Terms, the Privacy Policy and the California notice. Check them with your attorney before publishing a promotion.
brand.legalNameHint: The registered company name, for example "Mi Marca LLC".
brand.legalEntityHint: How the Terms describe the company, for example "a Texas limited liability company".
brand.legalStateHint: The state whose laws govern the Terms, for example "Texas".
brand.legalVenueHint: The courts named in the Terms, for example "Travis County, Texas".
brand.emailHint: Shown in the footer, the Privacy Policy and the help texts.
brand.domainHint: Only the host, for example mimarca.com. No https:// and no trailing slash.
brand.numberingHint: Prefixes use 2 to 8 letters or digits. They only affect NEW orders and promotions: nothing already numbered changes.
brand.entryPrefixHint: For example NUM gives NUM26-00000001. A promotion that already assigned numbers keeps its prefix.
brand.timeZoneHint: Decides when the day of the daily cash report starts and ends. Pick one from the list or type an IANA zone such as America/Chicago.

catalog.title: Catalog
catalog.description: Merchandise on sale, as the store sees it.
catalog.emptyBody: Create the first product with the button above.
catalog.emptyBodyReadOnly: No product has been created yet.
catalog.newBody: It starts as a draft. Publishing is a separate step, from its page.
catalog.fieldSkuHint: Unique internal code. Uppercase letters, digits, hyphen or underscore.
catalog.fieldStockHint: Leave it empty if you do not track stock.
catalog.bothLanguages: Both languages are required: the store is shown in both.
catalog.publishBodyDraft: It is a draft: the store does not show it. Publish it when the price and texts are ready.
catalog.publishBodyActive: It is published and on sale.
catalog.publishBodyArchived: It is archived: the store does not show it. You can publish it again.
catalog.noWriteCapability: You can see this product, but your account cannot edit it.
catalog.noPublishCapability: Your account cannot publish products or remove them from the store.
catalog.noEntriesNote: A product does not grant entries by existing: how many a purchase generates is decided by the promotion rules.
catalog.fieldKindHint: It decides how many entries each purchase of this product gives, under the promotion rules.
catalog.kindUnknown: This product's type is not known yet. None is picked for you: the type changes how many entries each purchase gives.
catalog.fieldImageHint: Choose a photo from your device or take one with the camera. JPG, PNG or WebP, up to 5 MB.
catalog.imageSelected: Selected image. It is saved when you submit the form.
catalog.imageTooLarge: That image is too large even after being reduced. Choose another one under 5 MB.
catalog.variantsCreateHint: Leave this empty for a single unnamed variant, which is what most products need. Add one row per colour or size.
catalog.variantsEmpty: This product has no variants yet.
catalog.variantSkuHint: Optional. Leave it empty and one is made from the product SKU.
catalog.variantStatusHint: There is no delete: a sold SKU is archived, never removed.

orders.title: Orders
orders.description: Purchases and the state of the entries each one produced.
orders.emptyBody: Orders will appear here once the store takes them.
orders.refundPending: Refunds cannot be made from the panel yet. When they arrive they will ask for a confirmation and a reason, because they move money and take entries away.
orders.searchPlaceholder: Order number, email or customer name
orders.searchEmptyBody: Check the order number (for example APP-00001234 or just 1234), the email or the customer's name.
orders.fulfillmentNoCapability: Your account can see the shipping status but can't change it.

orderCancel.title: Cancel this order
orderCancel.introCash: Nobody has paid this order. If it's a duplicate or the customer isn't coming to pay, cancel it: it leaves the pending-cash queue and can no longer be paid. Nothing is deleted.
orderCancel.introZelle: You haven't confirmed this order's payment yet. If the customer isn't going to pay or it's a duplicate, cancel it: it leaves the payments-to-review queue and can no longer be confirmed. If you already see the money in your Zelle or Venmo, don't cancel it: confirm the payment. Nothing is deleted.
orderCancel.introCard: This card order was never paid. Cancelling it first closes the payment at the gateway so nobody can pay it later; if the customer already paid, it is not cancelled. Nothing is deleted.
orderCancel.confirm: I confirm order {number} was not paid and should be cancelled.

orderFulfillment.carrierHint: Optional. For example USPS, UPS, FedEx.

dailyCut.title: Daily cash report
dailyCut.description: What was collected during the day, 12:00 a.m. to 11:59 p.m. {zone} time, and the merchandise to prepare.
dailyCut.transactions: {count, plural, =0 {No transactions} one {# completed transaction} other {# completed transactions}}
dailyCut.refunds: Card refunds made this day: {amount} ({count, plural, one {# refund} other {# refunds}}). They are not subtracted from the totals above, which are what was collected.
dailyCut.merchandiseEmptyTitle: No merchandise was sold that day
dailyCut.merchandiseEmptyBody: Physical products from the orders paid that day show up here, with their customer and shipping.
dailyCut.linesCaption: Merchandise from the orders paid that day

cashPayment.title: Cash payment at a store location
cashPayment.cancelledBody: This order was cancelled. There is no payment to confirm.
cashPayment.confirmIntro: Check the order number and the customer's details first. Confirming records who received the money and when, marks the order as paid and generates its entries with the same rules as a card purchase.
cashPayment.confirmCheckbox: I received {total} in cash for order {number}.
cashPayment.noCapability: Your account cannot confirm cash payments. Ask whoever manages the panel accounts.
cashPayment.retryIntro: The payment is already confirmed and recorded. This only repeats the entries step: it does not record another payment and it cannot create entries twice.
cashPayment.retryCheckbox: I understand this does not record another payment.
cashPayment.impactSameRules: Same rules as a card purchase

entriesBody.AWAITING_PAYMENT: A pending cash order generates no valid entries. They are generated when the payment is confirmed.
entriesBody.PENDING: The payment is confirmed, but the entries were not generated yet or the attempt failed. Retry below: it does not record another payment.
entriesBody.GENERATED: Generated with the same rules, data and entry numbers as a card purchase. They are included in the export to the sweepstakes administrator.
entriesBody.HELD: The order qualified, and its entries are held until the participant verifies their email, the same as with a card purchase.
entriesBody.NO_ENTRIES: The order qualified, but the calculation gave zero entries (for example, because of the per-person limit).
entriesBody.NOT_APPLICABLE: Under the Official Rules, this order does not generate entries.

notApplicable.NO_PROMOTION: The order is not associated with any promotion, so it generates no entries.
notApplicable.NOT_ELIGIBLE: The participant does not meet the eligibility requirements of the Official Rules, so this order generates no entries. The merchandise is sold all the same.
notApplicable.OUTSIDE_PROMOTION_WINDOW: The payment was received outside the promotion period, so it generates no entries.

participants.title: Participants
participants.passwordHint: Requirements are checked when you save.
participants.passwordSaved: Password changed. Their open sessions were closed; let the participant know the new password.
participants.emptyBody: Accounts created from the store will appear here.
participants.fullPiiNotice: For privacy, emails in this list are partly hidden for everyone, you included. Seeing a full account is a separate request, one at a time and with a reason.
participants.maskedPiiNotice: For privacy, emails show partly hidden here.

amoeReview.title: Free entry review
amoeReview.description: Entries sent without a purchase, awaiting a decision.
amoeReview.emptyBody: Entries sent without a purchase appear here as they arrive.
amoeReview.emptyFilteredBody: No entry matches the status you selected.
amoeReview.noPromotionTitle: No promotion is open right now
amoeReview.noPromotionBody: The review queue belongs to a promotion. It comes back as soon as one is open.
amoeReview.readOnlyNotice: You can read this queue but not decide on it.
amoeReview.payloadNotPublished: For privacy, the personal details that were sent are not shown here: only the entry and who sent it.
amoeReview.approveConfirm: I have read what was sent and I approve it.
amoeReview.rejectConfirm: I have read what was sent and I reject it.
amoeReview.noDecisionCapabilityBody: Your account is not allowed to approve or reject entries.
amoeReview.ledgerNote: Every approval is recorded, with where it came from, in the customer's entry history.
amoeReview.transcribedNotice: This card was transcribed by a team member.
amoeReview.capProjection: With the per-person limit, approving would grant {granted}.
amoeReview.capNoRoom: This participant has no room left under the per-person limit, so approving would be refused.
amoeReview.capUnknown: It is not known yet how many would count under the per-person limit.
amoeReview.appliedCap: Granted {granted} of {requested}, because of the {limit} per-person limit.
amoeReview.envelopeFlagged: This envelope carried more cards than the Official Rules allow. It was flagged, not rejected: the review decides.

adjustments.title: Adjustments
adjustments.description: Manual corrections to entries, with a reason and a preview of the effect before you confirm.
adjustments.newTitle: Who, which promotion, which way, how many
adjustments.newBody: This step changes nothing yet: it shows how the entries would end up so you can check before confirming.
adjustments.participantIdHint: Copy it from the participants screen.
adjustments.directionHint: Whether this adds entries or takes them away.
adjustments.quantityHint: A whole number above zero. The direction above carries the sign.
adjustments.draftInvalid: That draft is incomplete: it needs a participant, a promotion, a direction and a whole number of entries above zero.
adjustments.previewUnavailableBody: Manual adjustments are turned off, so there is nothing to check or apply. They are turned on in Feature flags.
adjustments.secondApprovalNotice: Second approval is turned on: this adjustment will wait in the list below until someone approves it.
adjustments.proposeConfirm: I have read the effect above and I confirm this adjustment.
adjustments.queueEmptyBody: Adjustments only wait here when second approval is turned on in Feature flags.
adjustments.cannotApproveBody: Your account can create adjustments, but not approve them.
adjustments.approveConfirm: I have reviewed this adjustment and I approve it.
adjustments.noAccessTitle: You do not have access to adjustments
adjustments.noAccessBody: Your account is not allowed to create or approve adjustments.

exports.title: Exports
exports.description: The entry data handed to the independent drawing administrator.
exports.emptyBody: Snapshots created for the independent administrator appear here.
exports.actionsPending: These actions cannot be done from the panel yet. The highlighted ones are those your account will be able to use.

draw.title: Drawing
draw.gateTitle: Nothing is drawn from this screen
draw.gateBody: An internal drawing does not run without a documented authorization and every condition met. This screen shows who authorized, who approved afterwards, and what is still missing.
draw.separationBreachTitle: Your roles allow both authorizing and starting a drawing
draw.separationBreachBody: Those two are meant to be different people. Ask whoever manages roles to look at this.
draw.emptyBody: Drawing authorizations appear here once they are created.
draw.noApprovals: No one has approved it yet.
draw.actionsPending: Authorizing and starting a drawing cannot be done from the panel yet.

audit.title: Audit log
audit.description: A history of everything done in the panel. It can only be viewed: no one can edit or delete it.
audit.emptyBody: Every audited action will appear here.

notConnected.title: This section is not connected yet
notConnected.body: This part of the panel is not available yet. Nothing is broken and nothing was lost, and there is no need to retry.

notFound.title: That admin page does not exist
notFound.body: The link may be out of date, or the section may not have been built yet.

reasons.CASH_RECEIVED_AT_STORE: Cash received at a store location
reasons.ZELLE_PAYMENT_VERIFIED: Zelle payment verified in the bank
reasons.VENMO_PAYMENT_VERIFIED: Venmo payment verified in the app

warnings.ENTRY_CAP_REACHED: The entry cap for this promotion has been reached.
warnings.BALANCE_WOULD_GO_NEGATIVE: The balance would end up below zero.
warnings.RULES_VERSION_ARCHIVED: The rules version this would fall under is archived.

drawBlockers.NO_FINALIZED_SNAPSHOT: There is no finalized snapshot to draw from.
drawBlockers.RULES_VERSION_NOT_ACTIVE: There is no active rules version.
drawBlockers.SAME_ACTOR_APPROVAL: Both approvals are from the same person.

flags.title: Platform feature flags
flags.body: Turn store and promotion features on or off. Every change asks for a reason and applies straight away.
flags.listHeading: Features you can turn on or off
flags.pendingBody: These were left pending from before. Review each one and approve or reject it.
flags.amoeModeUnset: You have not chosen how people enter for free yet.
flags.amoeModeHint: Pick the one your Official Rules describe. The system checks that it matches before applying it.
flags.legalDependency: Before changing it, check what your Official Rules say about {topic}.
flags.hasPendingRequest: A change for this setting is already waiting. Decide it above before asking for another.
flags.noMaterialCapability: Your account can see this setting, but not change it.
flags.noUpdateCapability: Your account can see this setting, but not change it.
flags.reasonTextHint: Optional, except when the reason is Other.
flags.materialNotice: This setting changes what the store says about how to enter. Check it against your Official Rules: it applies as soon as you confirm it.
flags.requestCreated: The request was created and is waiting for approval.
flags.confirmModeRequest: I confirm this change to the free method of entry.
flags.requestedUnknown: The requested value is not known.
flags.amoeModeDescription: How people who do not buy can enter for free.

hints.amoeEnabled: Lets people enter for free, without buying, in the way your Official Rules set out.
hints.visibleEntryNumbersEnabled: Shows each customer the numbers of their entries.
hints.internalDrawEnabled: Lets the drawing run inside the platform instead of with an independent administrator.
hints.stateEligibilityEnforcementEnabled: Checks that the customer lives in a state where they can enter.
hints.ageGateEnabled: Asks for the date of birth and checks the minimum age to enter.
hints.entryMultipliersEnabled: Allows bonus periods that multiply the entries from each purchase.
hints.entryCapsEnabled: Applies the per-person entry limit set by the rules.
hints.entryExpirationEnabled: Makes entries expire when the rules say so.
hints.winnerPublicationEnabled: Publishes the winners list on the site.
hints.manualAdjustmentsEnabled: Lets you add or take away entries by hand from Adjustments.
hints.provisionalEntriesEnabled: Allows provisional entries that are confirmed later.
hints.dualApprovalForSensitiveActionsEnabled: Asks for a second approval before adjustments and other sensitive actions apply.

bonus.heading: Bonus entry period
bonus.body: Creating it publishes a new version of the rules: a copy of the current one with this period added. It asks for a reason, like any rules change.
bonus.needsActiveVersion: This promotion has no rules in force yet, so a bonus period cannot be added to it yet.
bonus.created: The bonus entry period was created and the new rules version is active.
bonus.createdWithWarnings: The period was created, with warnings:
bonus.multiplierHint: 2, 5 or 10 are the usual ones. Any whole number is accepted.
bonus.multiplierDenominatorHint: Leave 1 for a whole multiplier. Use 2 for 3/2.
bonus.durationHint: The quick options start right now.
bonus.instantHint: Date and time in UTC, in this format: 2026-09-12T12:00:00.000Z.
bonus.conflictStrategyHint: What to do if two periods overlap. Only needed when the current rules do not say.
bonus.reasonTextHint: Optional, except when the reason is Other.
bonus.confirm: I understand this publishes a new rules version.
bonus.extendHint: It can only be extended, and not past the promotion's close. The site countdown switches to the new end.
bonus.extended: The period was extended and the new version is active.

rules.title: Official Rules versions
rules.body: Each version holds the configuration and the documents that govern the promotion. Only a draft can be edited.
rules.createBody: A new draft starts with every required legal key set to TBD, which is what blocks activation until the attorney resolves them. Cloning copies the configuration and the documents of another version.
rules.noCreateCapabilityBody: Your account is not allowed to create rules drafts.
rules.emptyBody: This promotion has no rules version. Create a draft to start.
rules.unresolvedBody: While any of these is unresolved, this version cannot be activated.
rules.emptyValueNote: An empty field is sent as TBD for legal text keys and as null for the rest. TBD is the honest state of a key that has not been decided, and it is what blocks activation.
rules.readOnlyNote: Only a draft can be edited. This version is shown read-only.
rules.jsonInvalid: This JSON does not parse, so it cannot be saved.
rules.advancedHint: The whole object. This is the only place where a key the form does not cover yet can be written.
rules.attorneyReferenceHint: How this version is identified in the attorney's file.
rules.documentsBody: The text is stored and rendered as plain text. Both languages are first class, and which one is legally controlling is set by the attorney.
rules.documentBodyHint: Plain text. Paragraphs are separated by blank lines.
rules.isInformationalTranslation: This document is an informational translation
rules.activateBody: Activating archives the current active version and puts this one in its place. It does not change the state of the promotion.
rules.alreadyActive: This version is already the active one.
rules.noActivateCapability: Your account is not allowed to activate rules versions.
rules.blockedByUnresolved: This version has unresolved legal keys or validation problems, so activation would be refused.
rules.confirmActivate: I want to activate this version.
rules.reasonTextHint: Optional, except when the reason is Other.

fields.qualifyingPaymentState: A purchase counts once the payment is (PAID = confirmed, AUTHORIZED = authorized)
fields.productEligibilityMode: Which products earn entries (ALL_PRODUCTS = all of them)
fields.productEligibilitySkus: SKUs in the list, if not all (comma separated)
fields.amoeRequiresReview: A person reviews every card (required for mail-in)

amoeTranscribe.heading: Transcribe a mailed entry card
amoeTranscribe.body: Type the card exactly as it arrived. It enters the same review queue as any other free entry.
amoeTranscribe.unavailable: There is no open promotion with a mail-in free entry method right now, so there is nothing to transcribe.
amoeTranscribe.created: The card was added to the review queue.
amoeTranscribe.participantEmailHint: If there is no account with this address, one is created without credentials so the entries can be assigned.
amoeTranscribe.preferredLocaleHint: The language it is written in. It becomes the language of the account created if this email had none.
amoeTranscribe.envelopeHint: However your team labels the envelope.
amoeTranscribe.cardsHint: How many cards came in the same envelope.
amoeTranscribe.cardsHintWithLimit: How many cards came in the same envelope. The Official Rules allow {max}; more than that is flagged for review, not rejected here.

payments.title: Payments
payments.description: How your customers can pay and which Zelle and Venmo accounts they send the money to.
payments.cardNote: Card payments are turned on by connecting Stripe; they can't be changed here.
payments.zelleEnabledHint: Buyers see your Zelle details, send the money from their bank and upload a screenshot of the receipt. You confirm the payment on the order once you see it in your bank.
payments.recipientNameHint: Exactly as buyers will see it in their bank when they send the payment.
payments.recipientLabel: Email or phone registered with Zelle
payments.cashHeading: Cash at a point of sale
payments.cashEnabledHint: Only if you have a physical point of sale where buyers pay and pick up.
payments.saved: Done. Checkout now shows these payment methods.
payments.readOnly: You can see payment methods, but changing them requires permission to edit the catalog.
payments.venmoEnabledHint: The buyer sees your Venmo QR code and username, pays from their app and uploads the screenshot. You confirm the payment on the order once you see it in your Venmo.
payments.venmoNameHint: As it appears on your Venmo profile.
payments.venmoQrHint: In the Venmo app tap your photo, then "Venmo me", and upload a screenshot of the code. If you don't upload a new one, the current one is kept.
payments.guestCheckoutOn: Since you only take Zelle or Venmo, your customers buy without an account: they leave their WhatsApp and name, reserve and pay.

zellePayment.title: {app} payment
zellePayment.confirmIntro: Only confirm after you see the money in your {app}. Confirming records who confirmed it and when, marks the order paid and generates its entries under the same rules as any purchase.
zellePayment.confirmCheckbox: I saw the {total} payment for order {number} in my {app}.
zellePayment.noCapability: Your account can't confirm payments. Ask whoever manages panel accounts.
zellePayment.awaitingBody: A pending {app} order generates no entries. They're generated when you confirm the payment.
zellePayment.verifyBody: Open your {app} and look for a {total} payment with the note {number}. A screenshot can be faked: what counts is the money in your account.
zellePayment.noReceiptBody: The customer hasn't uploaded a receipt yet. You can message them on WhatsApp to ask for it.
zellePayment.receiptCaption: Uploaded {date}. Tap the image to see it full size.
zellePayment.whatsappPendingHint: Opens WhatsApp with the message already written; review it and send it.
zellePayment.whatsappPaidHint: Let the customer know their payment is confirmed. WhatsApp opens with the message already written; just send it.
zellePayment.whatsappPaidCta: Tell them on WhatsApp their payment is confirmed
zellePayment.whatsappAskReceipt: {greeting} This is {brand} about your order {number}. To complete it, send {total} by {app} and upload the payment screenshot on your order. Thank you!
zellePayment.whatsappReviewing: {greeting} This is {brand}. We got the receipt for your order {number} and we're reviewing the payment. We'll let you know as soon as it's confirmed.
zellePayment.whatsappPaid: {greeting} 🎉 This is {brand}. We confirmed your {total} payment for order {number}. Thanks for your purchase and good luck!
zellePayment.whatsappPaidWithEntries: {greeting} 🎉 This is {brand}. We confirmed your {total} payment for order {number}. You now have {entries} entries in the drawing. Thanks for your purchase and good luck!
zellePayment.whatsappPaidWithNumbers: {greeting} 🎉 This is {brand}. We confirmed your {total} payment for order {number}. Your drawing numbers: {numbers}. Thanks for your purchase and good luck!

eligibility.title: Before you pay, confirm your details
eligibility.body: To check whether you can take part in the sweepstakes under the Official Rules, we need your date of birth and your state. We only ask once.
